diagrams.title: **Big pool, small window
diagrams.caption: **Big pool, small window.** From a large pool of possible inputs, the agent curates only the most relevant pieces into the limited context window. The model answers or calls a tool; results are stored, summarised or reused later.

diagrams.title: **Four ways to work beyond one window
diagrams.caption: **Four ways to work beyond one window.** Slide it, squeeze it, write things down outside it, or split the work so no single window has to hold everything.

diagrams.title: **Captured raw, kept summarised, found by meaning
diagrams.caption: **Captured raw, kept summarised, found by meaning.** The conversation lands in short-term memory as raw events; a strategy and the extraction module turn it into a summary filed under a namespace; later, a semantic search retrieves that summary for the agent.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 520" aria-label="End-to-end example. Short-term memory stores raw events: User84 says hi, I'm having trouble with my order 12345; the assistant says let me look up your order; a tool call lookup_order with order_id 12345.
